news.title: Liberty Shoes Ltd. Announces Joins Priyanka Vishnoi as Head of Marketing
news.body: Liberty Shoes Ltd. announced that Priyanka Vishnoi joins as Head of Marketing, bringing over a decade of brand and growth experience. In this new role, Priyanka Vishnoi will drive brand strategy, positioning and annual marketing roadmap for Liberty shoes. She will also lead integrated campaigns to drive brand preference and footfalls and look after PR & CSR initiatives for the Group. Prior to joining Liberty Shoes, Priyanka Vishnoi was with VLCC as Senior Brand Lead where she spearheaded pan-India marketing strategies, blending ATL, BTL, and digital campaigns for new clinic launches, among other things.
